description:
Room rent capping is the limit of hospital room cost that is borne by our insurance provider. This means that if the cost of the room exceeds the cap, the insured will have to pay the difference out of pocket.

So we always suggest to buy a plan with no room rent capping otherwise you can end up paying hospital bills yourself if you don't get the room of your category.

 We have tried to explain Health insurance with Room rent capping & without Room Rent Capping with an example.
